hooks.name: load-mcp-env-before-task
hooks.description: Load repo .env values and initialize Atlassian auth before any Claude task or STLC command runs

hooks.name: stlc-pre-task-validation
hooks.condition: task.command && (task.command.includes('stlc') || task.command.includes('/1') || task.command.includes('/2') || task.command.includes('/3') || task.command.includes('/4') || task.command.includes('/5') || task.command.includes('/6'))
hooks.script: echo '[STLC Pre-Task] Validating repository context...' && test -d .claude/config && test -f artifacts/state/stlc-state.json && echo '[OK] Repository and state validated' || echo '[WARN] State file may need initialization'
hooks.description: Pre-task: Validate repository structure, configuration, and STLC state before phase execution

hooks.name: stlc-pre-task-safety-check
hooks.script: echo '[STLC Safety Check] Verifying execution permissions...' && echo '[CHECK] Require user approval before execution' && echo '[CHECK] No destructive commands without approval' && echo '[CHECK] No dependency installation without permission'
hooks.description: Pre-execution safety gate: Verify permissions and constraints before running tests

hooks.name: stlc-post-task-artifact-validation
hooks.script: echo '[STLC Post-Task] Validating generated artifacts...' && test -d artifacts && ls -la artifacts/*/
hooks.description: Post-task: Validate all generated artifacts exist and are not duplicates

hooks.name: stlc-token-metrics-generation
hooks.script: echo '[STLC Metrics] Generating token usage report...' && python .claude\scripts\token-usage.py
hooks.description: Post-reporting: Generate token usage metrics per phase and agent

hooks.name: stlc-html-report-generation
hooks.script: echo '[STLC Report] Generating interactive HTML report...' && python .claude\scripts\html-report-generator.py
hooks.description: Post-reporting: Generate combined HTML report with metrics and execution results

hooks.name: stlc-traceability-validation
hooks.script: echo '[STLC Traceability] Validating requirement-test-execution linkage...' && test -f artifacts/traceability/traceability-matrix.md && echo '[OK] Traceability matrix exists' || echo '[WARN] Traceability matrix not found'
hooks.description: Post-phase: Validate end-to-end traceability from REQ to TC to execution

hooks.name: stlc-safety-violation-check
hooks.script: echo '[STLC Safety] Failure detected. Classifying root cause...' && echo '[ACTION] Review failure analysis artifacts before proceeding' && echo '[ACTION] Self-healing allowed for AUTOMATION_FAILURE only'
hooks.description: On-error: Classify failure type and enforce safety constraints (no assertion weakening, no app code changes)

hooks.name: stlc-state-persistence
hooks.script: echo '[STLC State] Persisting phase state...' && test -f artifacts/state/stlc-state.json && echo '[OK] State persisted for resumability' || echo '[WARN] State file not found'
hooks.description: Post-phase: Ensure state is persisted for resumable pipelines
